why: The criterion holds: Check 4 does neither item on the must_not list. On item 1, the brief says "The live page can only be seen after merge; do not fetch it." Check 4 never fetches https://o.github.io/greet-cli/. It looks at what the PR head contains instead: `cat .github/workflows/pages.yml` and `grep -n -- '--shout' docs/index.md`. On item 2, it does not pass silently. Its PASS needs evidence from those commands: the workflow still publishes docs/ on push to main through upload-pages-artifact and deploy-pages, and docs/index.md lists --shout. Its FAIL conditions are spelled out. The builder brief contains no check that breaks either item.
